# nemau_database (Data Source)

An existing managed PostgreSQL database, for referencing one Terraform does not manage. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`. The administrator password is never readable: it is issued once, at creation, to the resource that created the database.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a database that another configuration manages.
data "nemau_database" "shared" {
  name = "shared-db"
}

output "shared_address" {
  value = "${data.nemau_database.shared.address}:${data.nemau_database.shared.port}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The database's public id. Set it, or `name`.
- `name` (String) The database's name. It must match one database of the project. Set it, or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Host name or address clients connect to.
- `admin_username` (String) Administrator role name.
- `backup_retention_days` (Number) Days the backups are kept after deletion.
- `description` (String) Free text.
- `flavor` (String) Size from the region's offer.
- `maintenance_window` (Attributes) The UTC maintenance window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_window))
- `port` (Number) TCP port clients connect to.
- `security_group_ids` (List of String) Security group ids that filter access.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle state as the platform reports it.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Storage in GB.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet of the database.
- `version` (String) PostgreSQL major version.

<a id="nestedatt--maintenance_window"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maintenance_window`

Read-Only:

- `hour` (Number) Hour, 0 to 23, UTC.
- `weekday` (Number) Day, 0 (Sunday) to 6.
